title: Adaptive traffic-shaping experiment playbook and maturity checklist
creator: Lena Park
description: Purpose: Validate an adaptive traffic-shaping policy that routes requests to model variants based on latency cost and quality confidence. This ticket defines experiment milestones, evaluation metrics, canary gating criteria, rollback triggers, and operational runbooks for a staged rollout.
milestones: Milestone 1 - Canary design & infra prep: instrumentation, feature flags, circuit-breakers (complete)
Milestone 2 - Internal canary (5% traffic, non-customer endpoints): collect perf + quality for 3 days
Milestone 3 - Beta canary (select customers, 10-15% traffic): validate cost impact and UX signal
Milestone 4 - Gradual ramp (25% -> 50% over 1 week) with automated rollback checks
Milestone 5 - Full launch + post-launch regression window (2 weeks monitoring)
Milestone 6 - Postmortem and playbook codification into Console rollout templates
evaluation_metrics: End-to-end tail latency (99th) - must not degrade by >15%
Quality regression - mean ROUGE/BLEU or task-specific eval: difference <= 0.5% absolute
Customer visible regressions - error rate or bad outputs increase: <= 0.1% absolute
SLA breach count - zero allowed during canary and ramp phases
Fallback rate to baseline model - monitorable; acceptable <= 5% during ramp
rollout_gates: Gate A: Safety & infra checks (logs, traces, circuit breakers healthy) - required before internal canary
Gate B: Internal canary acceptance - all evaluation metrics within thresholds over 72h
Gate C: Beta canary acceptance - customer feedback survey median >= 4/5 and no security alerts
Gate D: Automated rollback rule set live - thresholds wired into Console alerts
Gate E: Post-ramp readout and sign-off by Eng, SRE, PM, and Product QA
decision_log: 2026-02-09: Decided to use per-route feature flags to control policy; avoids global restarts
